evals.prompt: I want to add performance monitoring to my Flutter app using Firebase Performance. How should I structure it so I can swap to Sentry later without changing my BLoC or domain code?
evals.expected_output: Creates PerformanceMonitor abstract interface class in domain. FirebasePerformanceAdapter implements it. NoOpPerformanceAdapter for tests/debug. DI binds PerformanceMonitor to FirebasePerformanceAdapter. BLoC/domain only depends on the interface, never FirebasePerformance SDK directly.

assertions.text: Response creates an abstract PerformanceMonitor interface — not using FirebasePerformance SDK directly in BLoC or domain
Response includes a NoOpPerformanceAdapter for debug builds and tests
Response binds PerformanceMonitor to FirebasePerformanceAdapter via DI — changing provider requires only a DI rebind

evals.prompt: How do I measure how long our checkout flow takes in production? I need to track it from when the user taps 'Checkout' to when the order confirmation appears. I also want to attach some metadata so I can filter results in the Firebase console.
evals.expected_output: Uses startTrace('checkout_flow'), putAttribute() with non-sensitive categorical attributes (e.g., 'payment_type': 'card_scheme' or 'user_tier': 'premium'), stop() at the end. Warns against attaching PII or sensitive financial identifiers. Shows the trace wrapping the user flow.

assertions.text: Response uses startTrace with a descriptive name (e.g., 'checkout_flow') and stop() at the end
Response uses putAttribute to attach non-sensitive categorical metadata to the trace for filtering
Response uses the PerformanceMonitor interface or PerformanceMonitorAdapter — not calling FirebasePerformance.instance directly in business logic

evals.prompt: How do I automatically track API response times for all my Dio HTTP calls? I don't want to manually add tracing to every API method.
evals.expected_output: Adds PerformanceHttpInterceptor to Dio interceptors. This automatically tracks response time, payload size, and status code for all HTTP calls. References the skill's Dio interceptor pattern.

assertions.text: Response adds a performance interceptor to Dio interceptors (not manual tracing per method)
Response mentions the interceptor automatically tracks response time / latency for HTTP calls
